mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, summary, publisher, publisher_type, publisher_dept, top_flag, status, create_time, update_time FROM admin_notice WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_notice (title, content, summary, publisher, publisher_type, publisher_dept, top_flag, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{publisher}, #{publisherType}, #{publisherDept}, #{topFlag}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
